mechanism.productionRule: src/ast/parallel-indexer.ts resolveContainsTargetStmt: a `contains` edge carrying a line resolves at INSERT time by (s.name = leaf(target), ORDER BY same-file DESC, line_start DESC, ...). parallel-indexer.ts:4393-4397 keeps that eager resolve for `contains` even when resolution is deferred for every other type. (Source citation, not a number.)
mechanism.modelRule: script/m14/incoming-rule.ts classifyEdge(declCount, kinds, tgt, claim, facts) reads ONLY a project-wide declaration count keyed by name and by qualifiedName alias (script/m14/incoming-gate.ts:669-695). It has no file parameter and no line parameter, so it cannot express `the declaration in this edge's own file`. (Source citation, not a number.)
mechanism.consequence: an edge production binds to its own file's declaration is counted `ambDeclOnly` by the model whenever the bare local name occurs more than once in the project — which for markup it always does (`path`, `name`, `item`, `template`).
